reuse.why: Writes the furthest-from-zero rule inline in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions instead of changing the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which the UI and other paths already use for ranged amounts.

duplication.why: Adds yet another inline ranged-amount formula next to the existing midpoint copies in getScheduledAmount, schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: The file is the right one, but the rule is buried inside one consumer rather than in the shared amount helper.

scope.why: Small and focused: one expression plus a test.

maintainability.why: Only the preview path follows the new rule; posting, rule actions, forecasting, budget templates and the UI keep the midpoint, so the app disagrees with itself and the rule has one more copy to find.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions computes the ranged amount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: Only computeSchedulePreviewTransactions changes; getScheduledAmount, server/schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts still apply the midpoint.
